title: Hannah Lynn shares her first new single, "Like That"
htmlContent:
17-year-old female singer-songwriter Hannah Lynn shares her first new single, "Like That," a song that showcases her outstanding talent and unique voice from her new album "It's All Good." Hannah Lynn has shown expansion and adultness in her music and is ready to take the lead in the music industry. It's exciting, and where Hannah Lynn is heading will prove the future.

She intends on creating a sequel to "Like That" from the album "It's All Good," which has remained quiet until now. The project "It's All Good" showcases the depth and complexity of teenage emotion and a much clearer view of who Hannah Lynn truly is. She wants her fans to feel the passion she delivered through the microphone and comprehend the lessons she discovered.
